title: Graph amendment record (Bounded Graph Amendments)
description: One append-only record per Phase-6 graph amendment, stored as amendments/A<NN>.json. The amended graph.json stays the authoritative DAG; this record is the provenance + the input to the validator's I17/I18/I19 offline checks. Records are never edited or deleted. NOTE: the human-gate policy (scope_change==true => human_gate==true; kind==cancel_unit => human_gate==true) is enforced by validate_run.py's I19 (state-machine.md §3.6), NOT by this schema's allOf — so an ungated cancel/scope-change reaches I19 and fails there with the I19 label (a schema-invalid record would be dropped before I19 runs). This schema keeps only the STRUCTURAL conditionals below (dod_refs presence for add/split; split shape).

directive_ref.description: I53 (1.14.0, Drift fix 1). OPTIONAL — a schema WIDENING, so nothing valid today becomes invalid. Points at the append-only directive ledger row backing a human_request trigger. I53-1 makes it (plus human_gate:true) MANDATORY on a human_request amendment, and I53-5 requires the file to exist. HONEST BOUNDARY: this records PROVENANCE, never TRUTH. Nothing mechanical stops an orchestrator writing a directives/H01.json, fabricating a verbatim_request and passing I53 — human_gate genuineness is already an admitted attestation (Limitation I) and directive_ref inherits it exactly. What changes is what a lie COSTS and what it LEAVES BEHIND: a fabricated quotation sits in directives/ where the maintainer can read it, and the act moves from UNMARKED to MARKED AND FALSE.

fuel_before.description: Fuel remaining BEFORE this amendment. WP2 tamper-evidence: validate_run.py I18 chains A01.fuel_before == expansion.fuel_initial, A(k+1).fuel_before == A(k).fuel_after.

fuel_after.description: Fuel remaining AFTER this amendment. WP2: I18 requires fuel_after == fuel_before − fuel_cost, and the last record's fuel_after == expansion.fuel_remaining.

retired_snapshot.description: Verbatim copies of each retired unit object from the pre-amendment graph.json (I19 reads tags + acceptance_criteria from here).

criteria_map.description: split_unit only: parent acceptance criterion (verbatim key) -> child unit id(s) now covering it.

revise_ops.description: AM-2/GV-12: revise_anchors payload — the ordered anchor-list edits. Each op names the operation, the (post-edit) item text, and (for edit/remove) the verbatim prior_text. OPTIONAL: absent on non-revise records => valid.

allOf.$comment: AM-2/I25: prior_text REQUIRED iff op in {edit,remove} (forward).
AM-2/I25: prior_text FORBIDDEN unless op in {edit,remove} (backward — strict iff; an add has no prior text).

list.description: AM-3/GV-12: which anchor list revise_anchors edits. OPTIONAL: absent => valid.

transcript_ref.description: AM-4/GV-13/GV-21: ref to the gate-dialogue residue backing a human-gated revise. OPTIONAL: requiredness on human-gated records is I19's job (mirrors the human-gate-policy-is-I19 note above), not this schema's allOf.

propagation_targets.description: AM-5/GV-17: unit ids the anchor revision propagates to. OPTIONAL: absent => valid.

propagation.description: AM-5/GV-17: attestation that no remaining in-scope unit needs the revision. OPTIONAL: absent => valid.

resequenced.description: I58 (1.14.0, Drift fix 6) — the resequence payload: the wave moves this record makes. REQUIRED non-empty when kind == 'resequence' and FORBIDDEN otherwise (allOf below). Every entry must have wave_to != wave_from (I58-3): a record that changes nothing is a FAIL, not a free re-run, because termination here is bought by FUEL alone and there is NO monotone measure over the wave assignment — a unit may legally go 5 -> 3 -> 5 across two records.

wave_snapshot.description: I58 (1.14.0) — the PRE-amendment wave map: every unit id in the graph before this record, to its integer wave. REQUIRED when kind == 'resequence'. This is STATE THE RUN DOES NOT OTHERWISE KEEP, and without it I58-4 is not decidable by any predicate over emitted artifacts: a run directory holds exactly ONE graph.json and no snapshot, baseline_units is an id set with no waves, and for the very population the clause polices — a pending, un-briefed unit the record does NOT list — the pre-amendment wave was recorded nowhere. Nor is it reconstructible: briefs carry a wave, but I58-1 restricts eligibility to units holding NO brief, so the two populations are disjoint. Measured cost: 113 B on a 14-unit graph, 369 B at the N0+fuel0 <= 46 ceiling. IMMUTABILITY, at the strength it actually has: it inherits the append-only record's existing trust level and NOTHING MORE — no predicate hashes an amendment body, so a retro-edit here is neither more nor less detectable than a retro-edit of units_added. The snapshot makes the COMPARISON decidable; it does not make the snapshot TRUE.

allOf.$comment: add_units/split_unit carry a non-empty dod_refs tracing to definition_of_done, and add >=1 unit.
WP3 kind closure — add_units: >=1 added, NO retirement (a pure addition).
WP3 kind closure — split_unit: >=2 children, EXACTLY 1 retired, a non-empty snapshot with id/tags/acceptance_criteria per item, and a criteria_map.

items.$comment: WP-A/B1: pin inner types so a schema-VALID-but-wrong-shape snapshot (e.g. tags:7) can no longer reach validate_run.py's I19 set()/list ops and crash it — the mini backend evaluates these nested item properties too.

allOf.$comment: WP3 kind closure — add_edges: edges only, NO unit add/retire/snapshot.
WP3 kind closure — cancel_unit: >=1 retired, NO adds.

AM-6/GP-4 kind closure — revise_anchors: an anchor edit (revise_ops+list), NO unit growth (units_added/units_retired forbidden) so no anchor edit is laundered inside a growth kind. human_gate==true unconditionality stays an I19 predicate (GV-13), matching the cancel_unit precedent.

I58 kind closure — resequence: a pure re-ordering. Carries its payload, its pre-amendment wave map and its frontier, and adds/retires NOTHING — which is exactly what makes I18's already-shipped `fuel_cost == max(1, |added| - |retired|) == max(1,0) == 1` the right and already-implemented charge, so the published global bound holds VERBATIM with no new term.

I58 strict iff, backward half: the resequence payload is FORBIDDEN on every other kind, so `grep -l resequenced` is an exact inventory of a run's re-orderings and no other kind can smuggle a wave move.
